craft_notes: Sthāyin: give-joy. Close: self-giving. Rejected: 'sacrifice' — killed: offer kept; 'devotee' — killed: self kept.

lines: Then fragrant flowers, as able, honor pay;
worship with love supreme, and give thyself away.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaiś ca yathāśaktyā samarcayet | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā svātmanaṃ ca nivedayet

reads_against.argmap: Fragrant flowers by power, supreme devotion — and self offered.
c1_essence: Fragrant flowers by power; devotion; self offered.
